Rajasthan woman sent to jail over alleged links to Pakistan-based groups

A woman identified as Babita, also known as Khadija, has been sent to judicial custody until June 29 by a special court in Rajasthan. The court's decision follows allegations that she has links with Pakistan-based militant organizations, including Jaish-e-Mohammed. The case is being heard by a special court.
